title: Orderly One API
description:
Orderly One DEX Creator API - Create and manage decentralized exchanges

**Agent quickstart — full graduation without a browser:**

1. Create an EVM wallet, then authenticate: `POST /api/auth/nonce` → sign the returned message with the wallet → `POST /api/auth/verify` with the returned `challenge` → keep the Bearer token.
2. Create your DEX: `POST /api/dex` (multipart form; `integrationType: "custom"` is enough — no hosted frontend needed).
3. Pay the one-time fee **and** create your broker in a single x402 request: `POST /api/graduation/graduate?brokerId=...&makerFee=...&takerFee=...&rwaMakerFee=...&rwaTakerFee=...` with your Bearer token — see that endpoint for the payment protocol (402 → sign EIP-3009 → retry with `payment-signature`).
4. Finish graduation by registering your wallet as the broker admin: follow the recipe in `POST /api/graduation/finalize-admin-wallet`.
5. Confirm with `GET /api/graduation/graduation-status` — done when `isGraduated: true`.

authentication.description: Orderly One uses wallet signature-based authentication. Users sign a message with their EVM wallet to obtain a JWT token.

flow.description: Sign the message "Sign this message to authenticate with Orderly One: {nonce}" with your wallet

flow.title: Verify Signature
flow.description: POST /auth/verify with address and signature to get JWT token

flow.title: Use Token
flow.description: Include the JWT token in Authorization header for all subsequent requests

endpoints.description:
Verify a graduation payment transaction and create the broker ID. Two ways to pay:

1. **x402 (agent-friendly)** — call `POST /api/graduation/graduate` first, optionally with `brokerId` + fee query parameters and a Bearer token for **single-fetch auto-finalization** (the broker is registered automatically once the payment settles, no separate call needed). Otherwise, once the payment settles (200), read the settlement transaction hash from the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` response header and pass it here as `txHash` together with the chain you paid on (`"base" | "arbitrum" | "ethereum"`) and `paymentType: "usdc"`. The paying wallet must belong to the Bearer-authenticated account.

2. **Manual transfer** — send an ERC-20 transfer of USDC/ORDER/USDT to the receiver address from `GET /fee-options` on any accepted chain and pass its `txHash` here.

In both cases the broker ID is created by this call, but graduation is not finished: register your admin wallet via `POST /api/graduation/finalize-admin-wallet` (see its description for the registration recipe) and confirm with `GET /api/graduation/graduation-status` (`isGraduated: true`).

If verification permanently fails after an x402 payment, the fee can be reclaimed via `POST /api/graduation/refund`.

responses.description: Transaction verified and broker created successfully

endpoints.description: Refunds a settled x402 graduation payment that was not consumed by graduation. Use when POST /api/graduation/graduate returned 200 (payment settled) but POST /api/graduation/verify-tx failed or was never completed. The authenticated user must be the EIP-3009 payer of the settlement. Once refunded, the settlement transaction can no longer be used for graduation.

responses.description: Invalid request, non-x402 transaction, or already used/refunded
Too many refund attempts — retry after the cooldown

Finalize the admin wallet setup and mark DEX as graduated. This is the last step of graduation: it binds the admin wallet's Orderly account to the broker (on-chain FeeManager `setBrokerAccountId` + broker API `updateAdminAccount`) and sets `isGraduated: true`.

**Prerequisite — register your wallet as an Orderly account first** (an EIP-712-signed registration against the Orderly API at `http://orderly-gateway-rest`):

1. `GET http://orderly-gateway-rest/v1/registration_nonce?address={yourAddress}` → `data.registration_nonce`
2. Sign EIP-712 typed data with your wallet:
   - domain: `{ name: "Orderly", version: "1", chainId: <your EVM chainId, e.g. 421614>, verifyingContract: "0xCcCCccccCCCCcCCCCCCcCcCccCcCCCcCcccccccC" }`
   - types: `Registration: [ { name: "brokerId", type: "string" }, { name: "chainId", type: "uint256" }, { name: "timestamp", type: "uint64" }, { name: "registrationNonce", type: "uint256" } ]`
   - message: `{ brokerId, chainId, timestamp: <current time in ms>, registrationNonce: <nonce from step 1> }`
3. `POST http://orderly-gateway-rest/v1/register_account` with JSON body `{ message, signature, userAddress }` → `data.account_id` (keep the same brokerId and address you graduated with)

Then call this endpoint with an **empty JSON body** (`{}`) — the EOA path binds the Bearer-authenticated user's own wallet as the admin. The multisig/delegate fields are for browser users with an Orderly delegate contract; agents should omit both.

Call `GET /api/graduation/graduation-status` afterwards to confirm `isGraduated: true`.

responses.description: Forbidden - caller is not the authorized signer for the admin wallet

Agents that prefer not to build transactions manually can instead pay the USDC fee via the x402 HTTP-native payment protocol — see `POST /api/graduation/graduate` (payment requirements are returned in its 402 response)

endpoints.description:
Pay the graduation fee using the x402 native HTTP payment protocol — designed for AI agents. No Bearer token, account, or manual transaction submission required for this step.

Flow: send a POST. If payment is required, the server responds 402 with a `payment-required` response header (base64-encoded JSON) containing one payment option per accepted network: base (chainId 8453), arbitrum (chainId 42161), ethereum (chainId 1). Each option is an EIP-3009 (ERC-3009) USDC `transferWithAuthorization`. Pick any network whose USDC your wallet holds; an x402-aware client (e.g. `@x402/fetch`) signs the EIP-712 authorization and retries the request with a `payment-signature` header. On success the server settles the on-chain transfer and responds 200.

**Single-fetch auto-finalization (recommended for agents):** include the `brokerId` and fee **query parameters** plus your `Authorization: Bearer` header on the same POST. The server validates them before charging (invalid parameters return 400 and the payment is canceled, nothing is paid), and once the payment settles it registers the broker automatically — no second call needed. Poll `GET /api/graduation/status` afterwards to confirm.

**Two-step fallback:** omit the query parameters; after a 200, read the settlement transaction hash from the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` response header (base64 JSON, field `.transaction`), then call `POST /api/graduation/verify-tx` with `{ txHash, chain: "base" | "arbitrum" | "ethereum", paymentType: "usdc", brokerId, makerFee, takerFee, rwaMakerFee, rwaTakerFee }` — using the chain you paid on.

If verification fails or graduation is not completed, the payment can be reclaimed via `POST /api/graduation/refund` (Bearer auth, same wallet as the payer) with the settlement transaction hash — the fee is returned on-chain.

**After the payment** (either flow), one step remains to finish graduation: register your paying wallet as the broker's admin account — `POST /api/graduation/finalize-admin-wallet` documents the exact Orderly registration recipe. Poll `GET /api/graduation/graduation-status` until `isGraduated: true`.

**Important:** without query parameters this endpoint requires no Bearer auth — the payment itself is the authentication. For auto-finalization the Bearer token is required, and the EIP-3009 payer wallet must be the same wallet that owns the Bearer-authenticated account.

parameters.name: brokerId
parameters.description: Desired broker ID. Supply together with all fee parameters and a Bearer token to auto-finalize graduation in this single request.

parameters.name: makerFee
parameters.description: Maker fee in bps (-0.5 to 15, 0.1 increments). Auto-finalization only.

parameters.name: takerFee
parameters.description: Taker fee in bps (1 to 15, 0.1 increments). Auto-finalization only.

parameters.name: rwaMakerFee
parameters.description: RWA maker fee in bps (-0.5 to 15, 0.1 increments). Auto-finalization only.

parameters.name: rwaTakerFee
parameters.description: RWA taker fee in bps (1 to 15, 0.1 increments). Auto-finalization only.

responses.description: Payment received and settled on-chain. The settlement transaction hash is in the `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` response header.
Invalid auto-finalization parameters (bad brokerId/fees, missing Bearer token, payer mismatch, no DEX, already graduated, broker ID taken). The payment is canceled — nothing is charged.
Auto-finalization query parameters supplied without a valid Bearer token. The payment is canceled.

Payment Required. Payment requirements are in the `payment-required` response header (base64-encoded JSON). Retry the request with a `payment-signature` header containing the signed EIP-3009 authorization.
